# recorded-run

The six listings of the recorded run (`fixtures/listings/facebook/runs/2026-09-24-VkryjpwS6U2GBDh3k`)
whose assessment leaves core parts unknown, with the unknowns, GPU state and confirmed parts that
listing-assessment's own fixture records for them
(`services/listing-assessment/test/fixtures/cases/recorded-run/expected.json`). Three PCs have
the GPU not stated, so each gets the GPU question; the three with a named GPU do not. A
confirmed part becomes a check only when the template asks about its part type, so the
`psu_wattage` of 1123980543398026 is left out. Quotes stay as the record holds them (`GTX+1660`
is `+`-encoded in the dataset).
